Now I understand the BoundingBox3D structure. It has two members: Min and Max, both of type Point3D. I need to implement collision detection between pairs of bounding boxes. Two 3D boxes collide if they overlap in all three dimensions.

The algorithm will:
1. Iterate through all pairs of boxes (i, j) where i < j to avoid duplicates and self-comparisons
2. For each pair, check if they overlap in x, y, and z dimensions
3. Two boxes overlap in a dimension if their intervals overlap (not just touch at edges)
4. Add the pair to results if they collide in all three dimensions

I'll implement this with a simple nested loop approach since the problem asks for a simplified version.
